page.layout: One block of Latin verse in italic, full width, at the top; below it a full-width German title in black letter; below that a German verse stanza in black letter; the catchword and signature at the foot right and centre. No marginal notes.

p.i: Nam quid adhuc superest? si te neq; provocat ar- Suiq; prodiga charitas. (dens,[?] O bis marmoreum pectus! neq; mitigat unquam Adeo profusa benignitas: Si neq; tantarum vel spes certissima rerum Expergefacit, & allicit: Si neq; tartarea cohibet formido Gehennæ: Nec ullus admonet pudor; Imò si durant magis hæc adduntq; stuporem Tàm multa tàmq; insignia, Vt facile immanesq; feras, chalybémq;, petramq; Rigore vitio molliant: Quid faciat pietas, quibus artibus abstrahat ultrò Devota morti pectora? Invitum servare nec est mentis puto sana, Et patria prohibet æquitas.

head.bl: Ein heilsame ermanung deß Kind-leins Jesu an den Sünder/ gezo-gen auß Erasmo Roterodamo/ vnd in Teutsche reimen verfasset/ durch Herrn Bilibald Pirckeymer.

p.bl: Jeweil bey mir allein man findet/ Was Güter allenthalben findt: Im Himmel und auff Erden. Wie thöricht ist/ der anderst wo Die schöpffen will/ und suchet/ da. Sie nit gefunden werden?

page.notes: The parenthesis-like mark "(dens," at the end of the second Latin line is doubtful; it may be a stray or a partly printed word. The Latin verse block is treated as one stanza. Underlining under "Quid faciat pietas" is in the print. Long s is plain s throughout; u/v is normalised by vowel/consonant function ("vnd" to "und", "Inuitum" to "Invitum", "seruare" to "servare"). Black letter is marked with bl, since it appears within a roman and italic page. Hyphen at line end "Kind-leins" and "gezo-gen" kept as printed.
